'''Spice ampoules''' were containers which were intended for the transport of [[spice]]. The ampoules, made of [[surgical plastic]], were surgically implanted under the skin of drug couriers in order to [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggle]] the spice along unnoticed by security forces. Suitably sealed, one container would last for at least 12 hours. At the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], this method was popular amongst the [[Black Sun]] underworld syndicate on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].
